jobs.title: Chargé de soutien aux programmes et à l'administration
jobs.description: Cette mission de 5 mois soutient la coordination, l'administration et le suivi des projets internationaux et des activités des parties prenantes dans un environnement multiculturel. Le rôle combine le soutien aux projets, la recherche, la rédaction de rapports, la coordination d'événements et les responsabilités administratives tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec un large éventail de partenaires internes et externes. Chargé de soutien aux programmes et à l'administration Organisation internationale Description Préparer des briefings, notes de réunion, rapports, présentations et correspondances. Effectuer des recherches et compiler des informations de fond pour les projets et initiatives. Soutenir la coordination et le suivi des programmes, projets et activités des parties prenantes. Surveiller les échéances, points d'action et livrables des projets. Organiser des réunions, ateliers et événements, y compris la logistique et la documentation. Tenir à jour les dossiers, bases de données, listes de contacts et systèmes de gestion documentaire. Assister dans le reporting d'avancement, le suivi budgétaire et les activités de planification des programmes. Assurer la liaison avec les équipes internes, partenaires externes et parties prenantes clés. Préparer des synthèses, analyses et rapports de gestion. Fournir un soutien administratif et de coordination quotidien à la haute direction. Profil Licence en droit, économie, relations internationales, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe. Minimum 6 ans d'expérience pertinente en soutien de projet, coordination de programme, administration ou opérations. Solides compétences analytiques, de recherche et de rédaction de rapports. Excellentes compétences organisationnelles avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités. Expérience dans la préparation de rapports professionnels, présentations et documents de briefing. Grande attention aux détails et capacités de gestion de l'information. Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et en gestion des parties prenantes. Maîtrise écrite et orale de l'anglais et du français. La connaissance de l'arabe serait un atout important. Connaissance avancée des outils Microsoft Office et des plateformes collaboratives. Offre d'emploi Exposition à des projets internationaux et à des parties prenantes de haut niveau. Environnement de travail dynamique, multiculturel et collaboratif. Responsabilités variées combinant coordination, administration et soutien aux projets. Opportunité de contribuer à des initiatives régionales à fort impact.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Geneva
jobs.description: Very fine SME with some 60 employees, Tekhne SA is a company that values quality and dialogue both internally and with its clients and partners. Present in Lausanne, Geneva, Fribourg and Bern, it specialises in project management, construction management and delegated project ownership. Having won numerous prestigious architecture competitions, its references in terms of public and private works are as numerous as they are prestigious. To strengthen the Geneva branch , we have been mandated to search for a Senior Project Manager With experience in AMO and/or RMO Your responsibilities You support project owners in the management and realisation of their construction projects, from initial considerations to completion. Attuned to their expectations, you translate them into clear objectives and realistic solutions, while ensuring respect for qualitative, financial and time-related issues. You contribute to defining specifications, analyse project feasibility and surround yourself with the necessary expertise for their successful execution. As a true interface between the various stakeholders, you coordinate contractors, companies and partners, structure exchanges and ensure the smooth flow of information. Close to your clients, you advise them in their decision-making and provide regular reporting on the progress of operations. Both operational and strategic, you maintain a global vision of the projects at all times and actively contribute to their success. Your profile Reliable, committed and pragmatic, you have a strong sense of responsibility and are recognised for your ability to advance projects. Your listening skills, interpersonal ease and architectural sensitivity allow you to understand the expectations of your interlocutors and to unite partners with diverse interests. Endowed with natural leadership, you appreciate collaborative work while knowing how to take a step back and maintain a global and strategic vision. Holder of a higher education degree in architecture, engineering or an equivalent field, you have acquired confirmed experience in managing construction projects in Switzerland. Ideally with a background in AMO, RMO or a comparable role, you master the Swiss construction environment, its stakeholders, processes and administrative procedures.

jobs.title: Réceptionniste auxiliaire itinérant(e) sur appel - Région Genève
jobs.description: Dans le cadre de mandats pour plusieurs de nos clients, nous recherchons des réceptionnistes auxiliaires itinérant(e)s avec un taux d'activité variable pour assurer des remplacements ponctuels et renforcer les équipes d'accueil de différents sites situés dans la région de Genève. Il s'agit d'un contrat sur appel, nécessitant une grande flexibilité et une disponibilité régulière, notamment pour intervenir parfois dans des délais courts selon les besoins de nos clients. Réceptionniste auxiliaire itinérant(e) sur appel - Région Genève Chez nous, tu peux faire bouger les choses. Vos missions Assurer l'accueil physique et téléphonique des visiteurs, clients et collaborateurs Orienter et renseigner les visiteurs avec professionnalisme Gérer les entrées et sorties (badges, registres, annonces de visiteurs) Réceptionner et distribuer le courrier ainsi que les colis Traiter les appels, emails et demandes diverses Veiller à la tenue irréprochable de l'espace d'accueil Collaborer avec les différents interlocuteurs présents sur site S'adapter rapidement à des environnements de travail variés et à différents sites clients Ce qui te caractérise. Votre profil Expérience préalable dans une fonction similaire (réception, accueil, hôtellerie ou service clientèle), un atout Français courant à l'oral et à l'écrit Très bon niveau d'anglais requis Toute autre langue constitue un avantage Excellente présentation et sens aigu du service Très bonnes compétences relationnelles, discrétion et courtoisie Organisation, autonomie et fiabilité Maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels Grande flexibilité et disponibilité pour travailler sur appel Mobilité indispensable sur l'ensemble de la région genevoise Capacité à s'intégrer rapidement dans de nouveaux environnements de travail Voici ce que nous t'offrons. Nous offrons Une activité variée au sein de différents environnements professionnels Des missions ponctuelles auprès d'entreprises reconnues de la région genevoise Un cadre de travail dynamique et enrichissant Une expérience idéale pour les personnes recherchant une activité flexible et diversifiée Equans Switzerland Facility Management AG En tant que premier prestataire de solutions globales pour le bâtiment et l'énergie en Suisse, nous soutenons la transformation et la numérisation de nos clients et travaillons ensemble à la transition énergétique. Nos prestations couvrent l'ensemble du cycle de vie des bâtiments, sites, infrastructures et quartiers. En tant que leader du marché, nos clients bénéficient d'une gamme complète de services auprès d'un seul interlocuteur ainsi que de solutions à leurs projets élaborées de façon intégrée et en équipe. Nous disposons d'une présence dans toute la Suisse et employons 6500 personnes réparties sur 140 sites. Cela nous permet de mettre en œuvre efficacement des projets aussi bien régionaux que couvrant tout le pays. Outre la technique et l'automation des bâtiments ainsi que le Facility Management, notre offre comprend également des spécialisations telles que l'approvisionnement en énergie, les transports, les télécommunications, la numérisation et l'optimisation énergétique. Nous concevons, construisons et réalisons ainsi des projets qui s'étendent de bâtiments intelligents à des centrales électriques d'avenir en passant par des tunnels. jobs.title: Senior Event Planning Manager
jobs.description: People at 1800 metres above sea level shape luxury mountain travel. Our dynamic and international team offers our guests smart luxury for an unparalleled holiday experience. As a team member of the luxurious Kulm Group, you are part of the key to our success. Together we make every stay inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we live our culture: discreet luxury, inspiration and life experience. Together we make this possible. This is your chance to become part of our defining culture: What you will achieve with us Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high-profile business events and bespoke celebrations – across two of Switzerland’s most renowned establishments. As Event Planning Manager , you accompany the entire planning process from enquiry to operational handover and ensure that every event is precisely planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed at both the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina. Your responsibilities: Operational detailed planning & implementation: Seamless takeover of confirmed bookings from Sales; detailed coordination of all processes including room concepts, F&B procedures, technology and individual guest requests. Hub within the house: Precise creation and timely distribution of Function Sheets (BEOs) as well as daily close coordination with Banqueting, Kitchen, Service, Technical Services and Front Office of both establishments. Presence & on-site support: Contact person for organisers and clients during the event on site, conducting briefings on location and ensuring smooth operation. Interface: Preparation and leadership of internal event meetings to ensure all operational departments are perfectly briefed and prepared. Leadership & quality: Leadership and development of the Event Coordinator as well as co-design of clear operational standards and templates. Follow-up: Recording all services provided in the PMS/CRM to prepare error-free final billing. Who you are Education & experience: Ideally a bachelor’s degree or training in hospitality, event management or business administration, as well as at least three years of experience in hotel events or event planning, ideally focusing on meetings, incentives, weddings and private celebrations in the luxury segment. Organisational talent: Exceptional attention to detail, a confident sense of priorities and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Process & system knowledge: Proficient use of PMS, CRM and event management systems as well as excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills. Personality: Reliable, solution-oriented and resilient; you build sustainable relationships with demanding guests as well as all operational departments. Language skills: Fluent and stylistically confident German and English, both spoken and written; additional languages are an advantage. Start date: October or by arrangement. If you would like to help shape the future of the event sector within the Kulm Group, we look forward to receiving your complete application documents. Benefits At the Kulm Group, our employees are at the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodation, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous discounts.

jobs.title: Event Manager (80–100 %)
jobs.description: The Goldau Nature and Animal Park delights around 450,000 visitors annually. On 42 hectares, around 100 European wild animal species live. Approximately 200 employees and numerous volunteers are committed to nature and species conservation, education, and research, and sustainably develop the scientifically managed animal park. Do you combine entrepreneurial thinking with a passion for events and hospitality? In this key position, you are responsible for the event business from the first customer enquiry to successful on-site execution. In doing so, you actively develop our event offerings and create special experiences in a unique natural setting. We are looking for a personality to join us immediately or by arrangement as Event Manager (80–100 %) Your tasks You are responsible for the acquisition, planning, organisation, and execution of events from A to Z You prepare and negotiate offers, contracts, and calculations and develop schedules You coordinate events with internal departments and lead or instruct the involved employees You maintain existing customer relationships, acquire new customers, and identify sales and additional sales potential You further develop the event offering and design new, attractive formats for day, event, and seminar guests You manage one employee and coordinate the staff deployed for events Your profile Education or further training in event management, hospitality, gastronomy, or tourism with relevant professional experience Several years of experience in independently planning and implementing demanding events Sound knowledge of gastronomy and a strong understanding of operational processes, quality, and service Strong organisational and coordination skills as well as a structured, reliable, and independent working style Entrepreneurial thinking, creativity, and a good sense for attractive offers and market potential Resilience and calmness, even with several simultaneous events Our offer Responsible role with scope for design and decision-making and the opportunity to actively further develop the event offering Meaningful work in a unique environment with nature and wildlife Diverse event portfolio with different customer groups Appreciative leadership culture and collaboration with committed employees Modern infrastructure and attractive employment conditions with various fringe benefits Application and contact We look forward to receiving your complete application documents, including your expected annual gross salary. For questions, Simon Widmer, Head of Hospitality, is happy to assist you at 041 859 06 31 .

jobs.title: ESG Officer
jobs.description: With our brands BMW, MINI, Rolls-Royce and BMW Motorrad, we are one of the world’s leading premium manufacturers of automobiles and motorcycles, as well as providers of premium financial and mobility services.
